title: MiniMax-H3 FL2VA A6000 short and final-AV long-production benchmark contract

supersedes.raw_historical_evidence_policy: Historical evidence remains immutable. Canonical v1 normalized records preserve explicit unavailable fields rather than inventing measurements.

source_grounding.name: MiniMax-H3 official model and documentation
source_grounding.license: MiniMax H3 Community License Agreement, license date 2026-08-02
grounded_facts: Open H3-Base output duration is documented as 4 to 15 seconds at 24 FPS with 32 kHz stereo audio.
FL2VA supports text-only, first-frame, last-frame, and first-plus-last-frame conditioning.
Ref2VA supports image, video, and audio references, but the local prepared model tree contains only FL2VA.
The visual VAE is temporally causal with temporal compression 4x; the transformer patch size is 1x2x2.

source_grounding.name: MiniMax-H3 official source repository
source_grounding.license: Repository documentation points to the MiniMax H3 Community License Agreement
grounded_facts: The official reproducible request scripts expose target duration and conditioning modes.
The canonical short prompt is the official T2VA Context-IR example reused by the pinned Sana workload.

source_grounding.name: vLLM-Omni MiniMax-H3 runtime
grounded_facts: The pinned pipeline rejects output durations below 4 seconds and above 15 seconds.
Output FPS is fixed at 24, output audio is 32 kHz stereo, and frame counts align to the 17n+5 boundary.
FL2VA accepts at most two keyframe images with first/last indices; it does not accept video or audio conditions.
The runtime tests accept 4 and 15 seconds and reject 15.01 seconds.

source_grounding.name: NVLabs Sana Sol-Engine MiniMax-H3 source
source_grounding.license: Pinned repository README declares Apache-2.0; bundled FlashAttention-derived notice is BSD-3-Clause
grounded_facts: The pinned MiniMax-H3 benchmark cell is 1344x768, 124 frames, 24 FPS, seed 0, and 50 steps.
The source prompt is t2va_example_1 and its local text hash is 98f36b879692095e099ae824c18d9e93e7006a490e082fd474a5f531769dcf06.
The source describes the 124-frame cell only; it does not establish native 30- or 60-second generation.

native_output_context.decision: The current pinned open-source MiniMax-H3 and vLLM-Omni path does not support native 30- or 60-second output context. Any such final AV must be labeled chunked_overlap, extension, or montage_stitching unless a later versioned source and real validation establish native_long_context.

conditioning.fl2va: one first frame, one last frame, or both first and last frames
conditioning.ref2va: documented upstream but unavailable in the prepared local model tree
conditioning.chosen_long_lane_mechanism: extension from the prior retained terminal frame using FL2VA

available_local_conditioning_assets.contract_use: provenance reference only; not a hidden static conditioner
inspection only; not accepted as a generation conditioner

capabilities.conditioning_asset_policy: The first long chunk is text-only. Each continuation condition is generated inside the same run from the previous chunk's retained terminal RGB frame; its decoded-frame SHA-256 must be recorded before the next request. No untracked remote or private asset may enter the workload.

practical_disclosed_approx.quality_requirement: Multi-prompt and multi-seed objective checks plus a separate human gate are required for a product-quality claim.

deployment_scopes.single_a6000: Exactly one NVIDIA RTX A6000 must be visible and used by each model process; physical GPU UUID is mandatory.
deployment_scopes.multi_gpu_production: Must be labeled separately and may not share a speedup denominator with single-A6000 results.

cold_e2e.start: before container or process start with declared runtime caches empty and model service absent
cold_e2e.stop: after final AV is written, fully decoded, accounted, and validation metadata is durable

warm_e2e.start: immediately before submitting the first production request after one excluded warmup in the same service lifecycle
warm_e2e.stop: after final AV is written, fully decoded, accounted, and validation metadata is durable

attention.rule: Attention is reported as a nested denoise submetric and is never added to denoise when accounting for E2E.

hierarchy.component_basis: Cumulative device seconds for denoise/attention/VAE and wall seconds for encoding/I/O must be labeled; unlike bases are not summed into a fabricated residual.

timing_contract.seconds_per_generated_second: warm_e2e median seconds divided by exact final AV duration seconds
timing_contract.historical_boundary: Existing accepted short evidence measured local HTTP request-to-download time, not canonical cold E2E. Normalized records preserve that boundary and mark unavailable components explicitly.

final_av_contract.video: H.264 or lossless review intermediate; final frame count, 24 FPS, 1344x768, and full decode are mandatory.
final_av_contract.audio: AAC or lossless review intermediate; 32 kHz stereo and full decode are mandatory.
final_av_contract.sample_accounting: Record decoded samples per channel, encoder priming, end padding, and effective samples. Effective samples must equal 960000 for 30 seconds and 1920000 for 60 seconds.
final_av_contract.incomplete_policy: A missing stream, decode failure, frame mismatch, unknown effective audio sample count, or duration mismatch fails closed and cannot be reported as a final-AV result.

long_horizon_noninferiority.rule: Identity, subject, background, camera, and motion metrics require a same-lane frozen baseline. Candidate degradation greater than 5 percent relative to that baseline is a failure; the first baseline is descriptive and cannot claim improvement.

promotion_policy.n1_gate: One seed. Require exact final AV, all mandatory metric fields, no automatic red flag, declared long mode, and no speedup claim.
promotion_policy.n3_gate: Three seeds 0, 1, and 2 or three matched pairs. Require N=1 pass first. Report distributions; still not a formal speedup.
promotion_policy.formal_n_ge_10: Only after N=3 promotion. Use at least 10 matched samples, preserve all failures, report median, mean, sample standard deviation, CV, min, max, and noise context.
promotion_policy.practical_quality_coverage: Before a practical product claim, use at least three prompts and three seeds, preserve every case, and pass the separate human gate.

speedup_denominator_contract.principal_variable: Exactly one named principal variable may differ.
speedup_denominator_contract.sample_requirement: Formal speedup or median improvement requires N>=10 matched samples.

accepted_historical_boundaries.final_av_30s_scope: Accepted only as a matched formal N>=10 30-second final-AV extension/chunked r10 guarded-adaptive step-min=3 timing/structural result versus retained r9_current_sol_attn on one A6000; not native long context, not BF16 fidelity, and not semantic or human quality certification.
accepted_historical_boundaries.sol_attn_scope: Only the formal matched same-GPU 5-step opt-in lane; not BF16 fidelity, not long video, and not semantic or human quality certification.
accepted_historical_boundaries.normalization_policy: The canonical fixtures retain accepted medians and claim boundaries. They do not manufacture missing cold/component metrics or create a new cross-track speedup.
